list.name: AgendaUBS
list.description: A full-stack application to organize appointments and care workflows in primary healthcare units, with a Java API, Angular interface, and PostgreSQL persistence.
list.problemText: Managing schedules, professionals, and appointments requires consistent rules and clear workflows.
list.solutionText: A full-stack project combining a Spring Boot REST backend, Angular frontend, and relational persistence, focused on business rules and modular organization.
list.architectureText: Java 21, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL, Flyway, and Docker Compose.
list.challengesText: Modeling appointment rules, separating frontend and backend responsibilities, and keeping persistence structured.
list.resultsText: Personal/academic project demonstrating full-stack integration, data modeling, and automated testing. Check the repository for current scope.

list.name: Pix Simulator
list.description: A study API for exploring transaction consistency, idempotency, and concurrency in simulated operations. It does not process real Pix transfers.
list.problemText: Concurrent operations and repeated requests can cause inconsistencies without appropriate controls.
list.solutionText: A simulation project to study validation, authentication, and consistent handling of concurrent operations.
list.architectureText: NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, Docker, and Nginx.
list.challengesText: Exploring idempotency, concurrency, transaction consistency, and rate limiting in an educational application.
list.resultsText: Demonstrates backend and infrastructure concepts. It is not integrated with banks, the SPI, or the real Pix system.

list.name: Ultimate SaaS API
list.description: A backend API exploring authentication, relational persistence, caching, and separation of concerns in a SaaS-oriented structure.
list.problemText: Business APIs need clear organization of business rules, persistence, and authentication to remain maintainable.
list.solutionText: Implementation of endpoints and data-access layers with token-based authentication and cache support.
list.architectureText: Node.js, Express, MySQL, Knex, Redis, JWT, Docker, and Pino logging.
list.challengesText: Structuring the architecture, standardizing logs, and handling authentication and data access consistently.
list.resultsText: Backend architecture demo. Check the repository documentation and code for current functionality.

list.name: SecureHub
list.description: A demo project for user management, activity records, permission levels, and data-protection concepts.
list.problemText: Internal applications need to control access to resources and provide visibility into user activity.
list.solutionText: A demonstration platform with management features and educational examples related to security and network scripts.
list.architectureText: Python and Java APIs, SQLite, and demonstration network/security scripts.
list.challengesText: Separating permissions by role and presenting security concepts without implying demo scripts replace production-grade solutions.
list.resultsText: Educational project; requires testing and security review before any production use.

list.name: Jitterbit Order API
list.description: A Node.js API for order management, with authentication and endpoint documentation to support integration and testing.
list.problemText: Order services need predictable operations and validation of incoming data.
list.solutionText: A REST API with organized routes, input validation, authentication, and interactive documentation.
list.architectureText: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, Joi, and Swagger.
list.challengesText: Combining validation, authorization, and documentation in an API that other clients can explore.
list.resultsText: Portfolio project focused on backend fundamentals. Check the repository for current endpoints and setup instructions.

list.name: Protocolo 360
list.description: A professional SaaS system for registering, routing, tracking, and public querying of administrative documents under a unique protocol number. Built on logical database isolation, allowing multiple organizations to share infrastructure with absolute data safety.
list.problemText: Public and private organizations require strict control and detailed histories of administrative document routing centrally, without any risk of confidential data leakage between different tenants.
list.solutionText: Developed a multi-tenant architecture with ORM-level query interception (Prisma extensions) and three-tier RBAC access control (MASTER, ADMIN, OPERATOR). Includes a public query portal with auto-obfuscated sensitive data and immutable audit logs.
list.architectureText: Modular NestJS backend with Prisma ORM (v7) and PostgreSQL. Logical isolation via Node.js AsyncLocalStorage dynamically injecting query filters. Redis caching and rate limiting. Frontend with Next.js 15+ App Router, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, and TanStack Query.
list.challengesText: Adapting to Prisma 7 dynamic connection schemas, automated filtering in batch transactions without violating TypeScript strict types, nodenext resolution conflicts, and interface decorator compilation in NestJS.
list.resultsText: Enterprise-grade scalable SaaS system with 100% fail-proof tenant data isolation. Supports tenant-customized protocol prefix generators and immutable audit-compliant activity logs.

list.name: PSF Digital (UBS)
list.description: A comprehensive enterprise-grade platform to manage scheduling, doctor rosters, and patient records in public health units (UBS). Features role-based access control (RBAC) and full Brazilian general data protection regulation (LGPD) compliance.
list.problemText: Public clinics face massive bottlenecks in patient scheduling, unorganized waiting lists, risk of sensitive medical data leaks, and difficulty integrating records across clinical sites (Multi-Tenant).
list.solutionText: Developed a Multi-Tenant Next.js web application using a PostgreSQL database. Implemented secure multi-tenant isolation, encrypting sensitive fields, and enforcing strict RBAC layers to restrict data access dynamically.
list.architectureText: Next.js (App Router), Node.js API backend, Prisma ORM for efficient PostgreSQL transactions. Caching and message queues via Redis, and complete environment containerization with Docker.
list.challengesText: Ensuring strict LGPD compliance for electronic medical records and preventing double-booking scheduling conflicts when multiple receptionists transact at the exact same millisecond.
list.resultsText: Check the repository to review the implemented scope and current project status.

list.name: Warehouse Management System
list.description: A web application for managing items, suppliers, categories, and stock movements, with a dashboard and reports.
list.problemText: Lack of real-time control over warehouse items, financial losses due to expired goods, and slow manual reporting processes prone to human error.
list.solutionText: Item management and traceable stock movements, low-stock alerts, and reporting features.
list.architectureText: Next.js frontend and Server Actions, MongoDB database for schema-less item versatility, and rich interactive analytical graphics via Recharts.
list.challengesText: Synchronizing stock calculations across separate physical warehouse warehouses and generating heavy interactive charts without degrading browser UI responsiveness.
list.resultsText: Check the repository to review the implemented scope and current project status.

list.name: Modular REST API
list.description: RESTful API built with high concurrency in mind, secure routing using JWT, and fully interactive OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
list.problemText: Need for a centralized authentication and resource microservice to serve web and mobile apps with low latency, robust validation, and high security standards.
list.solutionText: Engineered a clean Express API using MongoDB, applying modern Design Patterns, structured routing, global error middleware, and strict request schema validations.
list.architectureText: Node.js with Express, TypeScript for static type safety, MongoDB + Mongoose ODM, JWT for stateless sessions, and Swagger UI for documentation.
list.challengesText: Implementing a secure JWT workflow with rotating Refresh Tokens and setting up mock testing suites to assert reliable service coverage.
list.resultsText: Check the repository to review the implemented scope and current project status.
